o.text: From reduplication of sox- (“to push in, insert forcefully”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اورن (ören), from Proto-Oghuz اُرَنْ (ʾuran /⁠ören⁠/). Cognate with Turkish ören, Persian ویران (virân). Doublet of viran.
Morphologically from qapmaq (“to snatch”) + -ış. From Proto-Turkic *kap- (“to snatch”). Cognate with Turkish kapışmak.
